start: First workout start ever; a Wear OS watch connected without the MettleUp watch app; no demo

user_sees: At the top: 'Install MettleUp on your watch', 'See your rest timer, next set and heart rate on your wrist while you train.'
must_not: The card arriving after 2 seconds and pushing the sets down
The card in a correction or a resumed workout

user_sees: 'Opening on your watch...', then 'Check your watch: its Play Store is open on MettleUp. Tap Install there.'
must_not: Two Play Store opens from a double tap

user_sees: The card goes; the workout carries on
must_not: The workout stopping or losing sets

start: No watch, the demo loaded, a correction of a saved workout, or a watch that is not reachable

must_not: The card shown with no watch, on the demo or in a correction

steps.action: With the card showing, the watch drops off, then tap 'Install on watch'
user_sees: 'Your watch is not connected. Open Play Store on your watch and search MettleUp.'
must_not: A success line when nothing opened

start: The card was shown once before

steps.action: Tap 'Not now', then start another workout another day
user_sees: No watch card at the start
must_not: The card coming back on a later start

steps.action: First start, but the app is already on the watch and the phone did not know
user_sees: After 'Install on watch': 'MettleUp is already on your watch. When you start a workout, it opens on your watch too.'
must_not: An install offer that never ends
